description: The four flux controller images appear in the vendored toolkit manifest, so the kubernetes
manager sees them, but their version is whatever the pinned flux2 release ships, and the
flux manager tracks that release. A kubernetes-manager bump would produce a toolkit
manifest no flux2 release matches. Scoped to matchManagers [kubernetes] so the flux
manager's updates to them keep working.

packageRules.description: disable minio updates due to OSS unfriendly practices until a suitable replacement is found (all update types, deliberately unenumerated: enumerating types let replacement/rollback/bump fall through to override-calver with automerge on)
do not update pihole until blocky trial is done

description: Stop the kubernetes manager updating the vendored flux toolkit manifest. Must stay scoped
to matchManagers [kubernetes]: the flux manager legitimately updates fluxcd/flux2 via this
file, and an unscoped disable would stop those upgrades entirely. Overlaps the
kubernetes.ignorePaths entry in renovate.json but is not redundant: ignorePaths stops
extraction outright, and this rule keeps the exclusion if that entry is removed.
chainsaw fixture marker, permanently ignored: the image name is deliberately
unresolvable (imagePullPolicy Never) -- its job is to fail pulling so the observability
suite can assert the events are shipped. There is nothing to look up; every run
reported the failed lookup as a repository problem. Per-package on purpose: test deps
update unless excluded case by case.
kubevirt demo boot image for the virtualization suite, permanently ignored: pinned
'latest' plus digest as a frozen boot artifact whose guest OS is incidental, so the
only offerable update is a digest churn with no review meaning -- and that lookup
failed every run, reported as a repository problem. Per-package on purpose: test deps
update unless excluded case by case.
